CREATE TABLE "clarivo"."avatar_uploads" (
  "confirmedAt" timestamptz(3),
  "createdAt" timestamptz(3) NOT NULL,
  "expiresAt" timestamptz(3) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "key" text NOT NULL,
  "mime" text NOT NULL,
  "size" int4 NOT NULL,
  "workspaceId" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "avatar_upload_mime_2966695d" CHECK (mime IN ('image/png', 'image/jpeg', 'image/webp', 'image/gif')),
  CONSTRAINT "avatar_upload_size_12729bc4" CHECK (size > 0 AND size <= 2097152)
)

CREATE TABLE "clarivo"."conversations" (
  "closedAt" timestamptz(3),
  "createdAt" timestamptz(3) NOT NULL,
  "handoffReason" text,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "lastMessageAt" timestamptz(3) NOT NULL,
  "state" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz(3) NOT NULL,
  "version" int4 NOT NULL,
  "visitorId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "workspaceId" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "conversation_closed_timestamp_23fdbb3f" CHECK ((state = 'closed') = ("closedAt" IS NOT NULL)),
  CONSTRAINT "conversation_handoff_reason_8f0dc0d4" CHECK ("handoffReason" IS NULL OR "handoffReason" IN ('low_confidence', 'no_relevant_knowledge', 'visitor_requested', 'agent_off')),
  CONSTRAINT "conversation_state_52f142c4" CHECK (state IN ('ai', 'waiting', 'human', 'closed')),
  CONSTRAINT "conversation_version_ec05e13a" CHECK (version >= 0)
)

CREATE TABLE "clarivo"."members" (
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "role" text NOT NULL,
  "userId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "workspaceId" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "member_owner_only_56ac498f" CHECK (role = 'owner')
)

CREATE TABLE "clarivo"."messages" (
  "author" text NOT NULL,
  "body" text NOT NULL,
  "clientMessageId" uuid,
  "conversationId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz(3) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "memberId" uuid,
  "workspaceId" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "message_author_5961db72" CHECK (author IN ('visitor', 'agent', 'member', 'system')),
  CONSTRAINT "message_body_length_d02407bd" CHECK (char_length(body) BETWEEN 1 AND 4000),
  CONSTRAINT "message_member_author_09a2d8f9" CHECK ((author = 'member') = ("memberId" IS NOT NULL))
)

CREATE TABLE "clarivo"."visitor_visits" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz(3) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "visitId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "visitorId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "workspaceId" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "clarivo"."visitors" (
  "browser" text,
  "city" text,
  "country" text,
  "device" text,
  "firstSeenAt" timestamptz(3) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "language" text,
  "lastSeenAt" timestamptz(3) NOT NULL,
  "os" text,
  "page" text,
  "referrer" text,
  "secretHash" text NOT NULL,
  "timeZone" text,
  "visitCount" int4 NOT NULL,
  "workspaceId" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "visitor_visit_count_bdab665b" CHECK ("visitCount" >= 1)
)

CREATE TABLE "clarivo"."workspaces" (
  "accentColor" text NOT NULL,
  "agentName" text NOT NULL,
  "allowedDomains" text[] NOT NULL,
  "avatarKey" text,
  "createdAt" timestamptz(3) NOT NULL,
  "greeting" text NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "installedAt" timestamptz(3),
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "ownerId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "position" text NOT NULL,
  "settingsVersion" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "workspace_position_65a6608a" CHECK (position IN ('left', 'right')),
  CONSTRAINT "workspace_version_f3ba4a31" CHECK ("settingsVersion" >= 0),
  CONSTRAINT "workspaces_allowedDomains_elem_not_null_156d14ed" CHECK (array_position("allowedDomains", NULL) IS NULL)
)
